_comment: Story 6.11, AC12 — the mutation table, as DATA rather than as a paragraph in a story file.
Each entry names one property of the ceremony and the smallest edit that breaks it. The anchor
must match its file EXACTLY ONCE; the runner reports NOT-APPLIED as an outcome distinct from
killed rather than silently skipping, because a mutant that never landed is not evidence.
The oracle is the SUITE RUNNER'S EXIT CODE, never a grep of its output — a prose oracle is how
two earlier runs in this epic scored mutations against a harness that had collected 0 tests.

mutants.breaks: the shelf advances by TWO per trophy, so FR-26's luck meter over-counts from spin 2 and every later weighting is wrong
W3's cumulative walk becomes non-strict, so a draw landing exactly on a boundary picks the wrong candidate
Durstenfeld stops one step early — the reveal order and the pity byte total both move
`swept_out` is no longer byte-lex ordered, so the published set depends on map iteration order
W3's cumulative walk becomes non-strict, TypeScript side — the twin of G2
Durstenfeld stops one step early, TypeScript side — the twin of G3
`swept_out` is no longer byte-lex ordered, TypeScript side — the twin of G4
W8 takes the MAXIMUM over the co-winners' shelves instead of the minimum, so a shared award weights against the luckiest winner rather than the unluckiest
